faq.question: Q1. What is Gayatri Bank Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It refers to three separate notifications released by The Gayatri Co-operative Urban Bank Ltd. inviting online applications for the posts of Qualified/Semi-Qualified CA's, Junior Software Associate, and Law Officer.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for Gayatri Bank Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online is 21.09.2026 for all three posts.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application fee for Gayatri Bank Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is no application fee (Nil) for any of the three posts.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for Gayatri Bank Recruitment 2026 posts?
faq.answer: The age limit is not more than 30 years for CA's, not more than 28 years for Junior Software Associate, and up to 65 years for Law Officer.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification required for the Junior Software Associate post?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold an MCA, M.Tech (Computer Science and Electronics), or M.Sc. (Computer Science), with a minimum of 70 marks in academic weightage as per the bank's chart, and the post is open to male candidates only.

faq.question: Q6. What is the qualification required for the Law Officer post?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold an LLB or LLM degree, with a minimum of 5 years' experience in law practicing or in a similar position at any bank.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for Gayatri Bank Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection is through Interview and Documentation for all three posts - there is no written examination.

faq.question: Q8. How can I apply online for Gayatri Bank Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must visit www.gayatri.bank.in, read the relevant official notification, and fill out the online application form as per the given guidelines before 21.09.2026.
